meta.game: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-earth (BFME1)
meta.build: 1.06 'HD Edition' / BFME Foundation Project community build (NOT vanilla retail 1.0-1.06)
meta.text_source_priority_WARNING: The game can load text from TWO different places, and they conflict. Check BOTH: (1) lang\english.big -> lang\english\lotr.csf — the primary, binary CSF format, proper UTF-16, always renders correctly. (2) _patch106.big -> data\lotr.str — an optional legacy override (plain text file) that TAKES PRIORITY OVER THE CSF if it exists. It is read through the machine's single-byte Windows ANSI codepage (depends on the system locale of whatever PC runs the game!), so Cyrillic text in it turns into mojibake unless the system locale is Cyrillic. We tested writing this file as UTF-16 — the engine can't parse it, it throws a parsing error and breaks other fields too. Working fix: DELETE data\lotr.str from _patch106.big entirely (rebuild the archive without that file), which makes the engine fall back to the CSF. If the .str contained strings that don't exist in the CSF (we had 43 — new multiplayer maps added by the patch), you must manually ADD them to the CSF or they'll stay untranslated / missing.
meta.font_WARNING: The game's default fonts (Albertus MT, 'Generals', Arial, SachaWynter, Times New Roman) do NOT contain Cyrillic glyphs. You need to: 1) get a Unicode TTF font with Cyrillic coverage (we used Noto Sans, 256 Cyrillic codepoints), 2) put the .ttf file into an archive (any archive — the engine looks it up by filename globally across all mounted .big files), 3) rewrite lang\english\language.ini: point UnicodeFontName and LocalFontFile at that .ttf, and replace every Font= entry in headertemplate.ini and every *Font= entry in language.ini with the new font's name. IMPORTANT: check other .big files in the game root (we found duplicates in _patch105.big and ini.big) for DUPLICATE copies of language.ini / fontsubstitution.ini at paths data\ini\language.ini and lang\english ontsubstitution.ini — if they override your font config, patch those too, or you'll see either blank boxes or Latin-mojibake garbage instead of Cyrillic.
meta.hotkeys_WARNING: CommandButton entries (in data\ini\commandbutton.ini) have NO separate hotkey field. The engine DYNAMICALLY extracts the accelerator key from the '&' character inside the TextLabel string that is currently loaded for the active language (e.g. '&Retract' -> key R, shown underlined). If you simply strip the '&' and translate the text without it, the hotkey stops working entirely — not just the underline, the key press itself does nothing. If you leave '&' in front of a CYRILLIC letter, the key binds to that Cyrillic character, which isn't reachable from an English keyboard layout during play. WORKING FIX: strip the '&' out of the middle of the translated word, then append ' (&X)' at the end, where X is the LATIN letter from the original English string (that's the real physical key). Result on screen: 'Text (X)' with X underlined, and the key actually works.

archive_format.container: .big archive, header magic 'BIG4' (both base game and patches use this, not 'BIGF')
archive_format.tool: python library 'pyBIG' (pip install pyBIG) — Archive(bytes) to read, Archive.empty(header='BIG4') + add_file() + save() to write
archive_format.csf_binary_format: Header: b' FSC' + int32 version(=3) + int32 num_labels + int32 num_strings + int32(0) + int32(0). Per label: b' LBL' + int32 nstrings(=1) + int32 namelen + ascii name, then b' RTS' + int32 strlen + UTF-16LE text where EVERY BYTE IS BIT-INVERTED (~byte & 0xFF) — this is NOT plain UTF-16, you must invert bytes both on read and on write. (There's also a rare 'WRTS' variant with extra trailing data after the string.)
archive_format.str_text_format:
Plain text, one block per label: 'LABEL
"text"
END

'. Multi-line text inside the quotes uses a LITERAL two-character '
' sequence, not a real line break. Read as a single-byte codepage (cp1252 in the stock English file) — see text_source_priority_WARNING, avoid relying on this format.

meta.install_method: Don't rely on mount order between multiple .big files sharing the same internal path — that's undocumented and unreliable. The only guaranteed method: rename the original lang\english.big to a backup (e.g. english.bigorig) and place your archive under the exact name english.big in the same lang\ folder. The internal file paths inside the archive must stay 'lang\english\...' (that's hardcoded by the engine, unrelated to which language you're translating to) — only the CONTENTS of the files inside change, never the folder name.
known_gotchas: Files in the game root are named _patch105.big, _patch106.big etc. — the '_' prefix controls patch load order, don't touch it without reason.

The HD mod (separate folder like F:\BFME1HD with one .big + a '-mod' flag on the shortcut) has nothing to do with strings/fonts at all — it's models/textures. Don't confuse it with the patches, which are what actually break localization.

Version/language settings are NOT stored in the Windows registry and can't be changed from an in-game menu — we checked, there are simply no registry keys for this particular build (it's not a standard EA installer install).
Always back up the original .big (.orig / .bigorig) next to it before overwriting, after any edit.

Community patches like this 1.06/HD Edition build can ship NEW content (in our case, 19 extra multiplayer maps) that doesn't exist in the base english.big. Catch these strings separately (diff the label lists) and add them to the CSF by hand, or they'll stay untranslated.

russian_reference.note: Added 'ru' field to each entry, extracted from F:\BFME1\langussian.big -> Lang\Russian\lotr.csf (the OFFICIAL Russian localization, not a fan translation). Useful as a reference/QA aid when reviewing Ukrainian phrasing. This archive uses its own language folder 'Lang\Russian\...' (not 'lang\english\...'), confirming the engine DOES support real per-language folders when the localization ships one -- our Ukrainian fan-translation base just never created one and reused the 'english' folder instead, which is why we had to overwrite english.big rather than add a new language.

font_files_used_by_official_russian_loca.note: Official RU keeps the ORIGINAL font names (Albertus MT, SachaWynter) in language.ini/headertemplate.ini unchanged, and instead ships Cyrillic-capable font FILES under those same names via LocalFontFile private registration: AlbertusMT.otf and OmniaLTStd.ttf (OmniaLTStd substitutes SachaWynter via fontsubstitution.ini). Both files already exist in this game install inside data.big (paths: albertusmt.otf, omnialtstd.ttf) -- meaning a cleaner alternative to our Noto Sans approach would be to point at those instead of renaming every Font= entry.

meta.WARNING_if_game_version_changes:
If you install a different game build/version (different patch files), the following game-version-specific fixes will likely be LOST and need to be redone manually -- they were applied directly to the specific _patch105.big / _patch106.big files of THIS install, not via any repeatable script:
1) _patch106.big originally shipped data\lotr.str (a legacy plain-text string override, read via the single-byte Windows ANSI codepage) which TAKES PRIORITY over lang\english.big's CSF and breaks Cyrillic (mojibake) -- we deleted that file from the archive so the engine falls back to the CSF. A new/different _patch106.big (or any other patch .big) may reintroduce this same file/problem -- check any root .big for a 'data\lotr.str' entry again after updating.
2) _patch105.big originally shipped its own copies of language.ini / fontsubstitution.ini (paths: data\ini\language.ini, lang\english\language.ini, lang\english ontsubstitution.ini) pointing at the stock non-Cyrillic fonts (Albertus MT / SachaWynter), which override whatever font config ships in lang\english.big. We replaced those 3 files inside _patch105.big with versions pointing at Noto Sans (+ bundled NotoSans-Regular.ttf and OmniaLTStd.ttf for numeral displays). A different _patch105.big will need the same font-config files replaced again -- search ALL root .big files for duplicate language.ini/fontsubstitution.ini paths after any game update, not just _patch105.big by name (the patch numbering may differ in a new build).
3) General approach for a new version: 1) scan every .big in the game root for 'data\lotr.str' and delete it if present (rebuild the archive without that entry); 2) scan every .big for language.ini/fontsubstitution.ini duplicates outside lang\english.big and overwrite them with the Noto-Sans-pointing versions (see font_WARNING above for the exact content); 3) rebuild lang\english.big itself from this JSON using build_localized_big.py -- that part IS repeatable and doesn't depend on game version, since it only touches the CSF.
4) The 5 localized textures documented in graphics_WARNING are NOT part of build_localized_big.py's CSF merge -- they must be manually copied into the freshly rebuilt lang\english.big from this toolkit folder's own copies (logowithshadow.tga, titlescreenuserinterface.tga, load_w_ea.tga, lmtext.dds, solomordortransition_001.jpg) after running build_localized_big.py, using the same Archive.empty(header='BIG4') copy-all-except-target + add_file() pattern.

meta.archive_header_format_WARNING: CRITICAL: .big archives do NOT all use the same header magic. Most archives (lang\english.big, ini.big, data.big, textures.big, and every other base-content .big) use header 'BIG4'. But _patch105.big and _patch106.big (the incremental patch archives) use the OLDER header 'BIGF' instead. The HD mod overlay archive (F:\BFME1HD\HDEditionv1.0.big, loaded via 'lotrbfme.exe -mod \"...\\HDEditionv1.0.big\"') also uses 'BIGF'. If you rebuild _patch105.big / _patch106.big with pyBIG's Archive.empty(header='BIG4') (the default we used most of this session for other archives), the game's patch loader silently ignores/rejects the whole archive as invalid -- the game then behaves as if unpatched (falls back to base 1.03-era behavior) even though the files are still present on disk with correct filenames and content, no error is shown, and the strings/textures you added inside them simply don't take effect. ALWAYS check the ORIGINAL archive's first 4 bytes before rebuilding it (open(path,'rb').read(4)) and pass that exact same header string to Archive.empty(header=...) when resaving -- never assume BIG4 for every archive. Confirmed pairing for this build: _patch105.big=BIGF, _patch106.big=BIGF, ini.big=BIG4, lang\english.big=BIG4, HDEditionv1.0.big=BIGF.
meta.hd_mod_launcher_WARNING: This install is launched as: lotrbfme.exe -mod \"F:\BFME1HD\HDEditionv1.0.big\" -- a SEPARATE overlay archive outside the main F:\BFME1 folder, loaded with (presumably) the highest priority of all archives. Inspected it: 477 files, mostly art/ HD texture upgrades (visual only, not language-related) plus one asset.dat index. BUT it also ships its own lang\english\art\textures\logowithshadow.tga (446,310 bytes, its own HD-branded logo, different from both the stock English one and our Ukrainian one). Since -mod archives override base+patch archives, THIS logo will always be shown instead of whatever is in lang\english.big's logowithshadow.tga, regardless of what we do there. To make our Ukrainian logo show up when launched via this HD mod shortcut, HDEditionv1.0.big itself would need to be patched too (same logowithshadow.tga path, replace with the Ukrainian version). Not done yet as of this note -- current work only touches F:\BFME1's own archives, not HDEditionv1.0.big.
meta.patch_version_string_WARNING: The 'Version:Format2' CSF label is normally a printf-style format string (vanilla: '%d.%02d', literally combined at runtime with integer version constants compiled into lotrbfme.exe -- this is the mechanism that makes the game ALWAYS show '1.03' in menus regardless of which patches are applied, confirmed by disassembling the exe). HOWEVER, community patches (confirmed for patch 2.22, likely true for others) hijack this SAME label inside their own data\lotr.str override (e.g. inside _patch222.big) and replace it with a LITERAL patch build string like 'Patch 2.22v7.0.4' instead of a format string -- this is how the game actually displays the real patch version in the options screen footer, NOT the exe-hardcoded '1.03'. CONSEQUENCE: if you delete data\lotr.str from the patch archive (our standard fix for the legacy-codepage Cyrillic-breaking override), you ALSO delete this patch version string with it, and the game falls back to showing '1.03' again -- looking like patches silently stopped working, when actually it's just this one label losing its override. FIX: before/after deleting data\lotr.str from a patch archive, always grep it first for 'Version:Format2' (search the raw bytes for that label name) and copy whatever literal patch-version string is there into the CSF's own 'Version:Format2' label (via build_localized_big.py-style CSF rebuild) so the real patch version keeps displaying through the working Unicode CSF path instead of the broken legacy .str one. For patch 2.22 specifically, the value is 'Patch 2.22v7.0.4' (stored in this JSON's 'ua' field for var 'Version:Format2' -- a deliberate exception to the usual en/ua translation split, since this is a literal build tag, not translatable text).
meta.patch_2.22_new_content_WARNING: Patch 2.22 (community patch, files _patch222*.big) added substantial NEW content not present in the base game this JSON was originally built against: 732 new CSF labels were found in _patch222.big's data\lotr.str that had no entry in this JSON at all (added on this date with en text but empty ua -- NOT YET TRANSLATED). Breakdown: CONTROLBAR ~222 (new hero abilities/tooltips, including two entirely new heroes not in vanilla BFME1 -- Wulfgar 'IsengardWulf*' and Ugluk 'IsengardUgluk*'), Desc ~148, Map ~81 (new multiplayer maps: Dorwinion, Crossroads II, Dunharrow II, Buckland, etc.), OBJECT ~54 (new units/buildings), SCRIPT ~33 (mission/scenario text), plus smaller categories (BannerUI, various tooltip-*). These entries currently have ua='' which means build_localized_big.py's fallback logic (ua or en) will display them in English until translated -- that's fine, better than the engine's raw 'MISSING: label' placeholder that showed before these were added at all. Also: if a future game version drops _patch222.big / uses a differently-numbered patch, re-run this same lotr.str-diffing approach against ITS data\lotr.str before assuming the base 8028-entry set is complete -- patches keep adding new content over time.
meta.restore_from_backup_WARNING: Restoring any archive from its .orig backup (e.g. to isolate/debug a specific issue) wipes ALL prior fixes applied to that archive, not just the one thing being investigated -- font swap (albertusmt_ua.otf + language.ini edits), the SachaWynter fontsubstitution.ini fix, the CSF translation merge, textures, movie subtitle inis, everything. It's easy to restore-from-backup for a narrow diagnostic reason (e.g. 'restore stock English and check if label X exists'), get a narrow follow-up request ('now redo just the CSF merge', 'now just delete lotr.str'), and end up leaving the archive in a state where ONLY that narrow step was reapplied while font/fontsubstitution/textures/movies are back to stock -- producing the exact 'artifacts are back' symptom that looks like a regression but is actually just an incomplete reapplication. RULE: after ANY restore-from-.orig on lang\english.big / ini.big / any _patch*.big, always mentally re-run (or explicitly ask whether to re-run) the FULL checklist for that archive -- CSF merge, font, fontsubstitution fix, textures, movie subs, lotr.str removal -- not just whatever narrow step the user's next message asked for. Don't assume a narrow request means 'only touch this one thing' when the archive was just reset to stock.
meta.movie_subtitles_HasSubtitles_WARNING:
SOLVED + AUTOMATED as of this note -- see bfme1/add_movie_subtitles.py and the bfme1/movies/ folder (13 final, tuned .ini files) in this toolkit. Two things are required for cinematic/tutorial subtitles to work, both handled by that script:
1. data\english\Movies\<Name>.ini (SubTitleBlock) files added to lang\english.big -- the bfme1/movies/ folder holds the FINAL versions already: FontName = Albertus MT (not the stock 'Open Sans', which isn't registered), FontPitch scaled 1.2x from the original stock values (32->38, 42->50, 52->62 depending on the file -- these vary per movie, don't assume a single constant). Style stayed SOLID_FADE (stock) -- OUTLINED_FADE and TRANSPARENT_FADE were tried and rejected by the user ('без подложки вобще дичь' -- without a backdrop it looks terrible); 1.5x FontPitch was also tried and rejected as too big, 1.2x is the settled value. The engine exposes 4 discrete Style enum values total (SOLID_FADE / OUTLINED_FADE / OUTLINED / TRANSPARENT_FADE, confirmed by scanning lotrbfme.exe's string table) but no continuous alpha/opacity parameter -- it's one of those 4 or nothing, no 50%-style partial transparency is possible.
2. video.ini's Video blocks need the line 'HasSubtitles = Yes' or the engine never even looks at the Movies\*.ini above, no matter how correct they are -- this is a SILENT failure with no error shown. video.ini lives at data\iniideo.ini and can be duplicated inside ini.big AND/OR whichever _patch*.big is currently active (whichever one is loaded last wins) -- flag BOTH if both exist, add_movie_subtitles.py's flag_has_subtitles() handles this per-archive, call it once per archive that has its own copy.
The 13 videos needing the flag: Evil_AmonHen_Intro, Evil_Ithilien_Intro, Evil_NearHarad_Outro, Evil_ShelobsLair_Intro, Good_Lothlorien_Intro, Good_ShelobsLair_Intro, Opening_Game_Cinematic, TutorialBasesAndUnits, TutorialHeroes, TutorialMovesAndAttacks, TutorialSpecialPowers, TutorialVeterancy, TutorialWorldMap.
This whole mechanism (both the ini format and the HasSubtitles requirement) is LANGUAGE-AGNOSTIC -- video.ini lives outside any lang\<language>\ path in every build we've touched so far, so the fix only needs applying ONCE per game install/patch version, not separately per target language. But it DOES need reapplying after every reinstall or repatch, same as the lotr.str / fontsubstitution / BIG4 vs BIGF header issues -- a fresh patch's video.ini ships without the flag by default. Discovered by diffing against the community UA v1 package (github.com/clever-play-ua/BFME-Localizations, 001_BFME_1/004_BFME1_UKRAINIAN/v1/Ukrainian.big), which ships its own Lang\english\data\iniideo.ini override with the flag already set. data\ini\defaultideo.ini (a separate ~525-byte file with no video entries) is unrelated, don't bother patching it. UNRESOLVED as of this note: user reports the tutorial subtitle TEXT still looks like it's rendering in a different (wrong) font despite FontName = Albertus MT being set correctly -- possible that SubTitleType = CINEMA uses a separate rendering path (video-overlay code, maybe a raw GDI font lookup) that doesn't honor the same LocalFontFile registration as normal UI text. Not yet diagnosed -- waiting on a screenshot to tell whether the font is ignored entirely (falls back to a real system font) vs. loading but just looking stylistically different from the rest of the UI.
meta.missed_end_lowercase_WARNING: The original 732-label diff of _patch222.big's data\lotr.str used a regex requiring literal uppercase 'END' as the block terminator. 13 labels in that file actually use lowercase/mixed-case 'End' instead (e.g. OBJECT:GondorDamrod, OBJECT:Grishnakh, CONTROLBAR:ShatteredHope/WretchedFate and their tooltips, CONTROLBAR:Calltoarms, OBJECT:HordeGondorRangerSword, OBJECT:Shanks, OBJECT:Dimek) and were silently skipped by that first pass -- they showed as blank/missing in-game even though everything else (font, CSF merge, video.ini) was correct. Re-diffed with re.IGNORECASE on the END token and found + translated all 13. LESSON: any future re-diff of a .str file must match 'End' case-insensitively, not just 'END'.
meta.ea_official_vs_community_patch_methodolo:
How EA's OWN official language patches (e.g. Thai 1.00 -> 1.03, which added new strings translated into Thai) actually worked, vs. how the community's patch 2.22 works, and why that distinction matters for us:

EA's method (the 'correct' way, and the one we already follow for lang\english.big): root-level incremental _patchNNN.big archives CANNOT touch lang\<language>\lotr.csf at all (confirmed empirically -- _patch222.big itself ships zero .csf files, only data\lotr.str). So the only way EA could add new Thai strings in a patch was to ship a COMPLETE REPLACEMENT lang\thai.big (old text + new text, all in one rebuilt CSF), not an incremental patch archive. This is exactly what our build_localized_big.py / rebuild_lang_english.py scripts do to lang\english.big -- merge old CSF + patch-2.22's new labels + our ua translation into one CSF and resave the whole archive. THIS is our equivalent of an official 'lang\ukrainian.big' patch release, not _patch223.big.

Community patch 2.22's method (a cheap shortcut that only works for English): instead of rebuilding lang\english.big, they stuffed old+new strings into data\lotr.str via a normal root-level incremental patch. This works for them ONLY because English is plain ASCII -- the single-byte legacy .str codepage is indifferent to which codepage is active when the text is pure ASCII. It would NOT work for Cyrillic/Thai/anything non-Latin (this is the exact same single-byte-codepage limitation documented in text_source_priority_WARNING) -- putting our translated text into a .str this way would reproduce the original mojibake bug, not fix anything.

CONSEQUENCE / rule of thumb: _patch223.big (or any root-level _patchN.big we add) is ONLY the right tool for data\ini\*.ini and data\lotr.str fixes (fontsubstitution, video.ini HasSubtitles, neutralizing patch222's own English .str by shipping an EMPTY one at higher priority). It is architecturally the wrong tool for shipping translated text, font files, or movie-subtitle .ini files -- those three MUST go through a full lang\english.big rebuild, exactly like an official EA language patch would. Don't try to move CSF/font/movies content into a _patchN.big again; it can't reach lang\ paths, full stop.
meta.patch223_overlay_ABANDONED_WARNING:
The _patch223.big drop-in overlay idea (a separate _patch<N+1>.big sitting next to _patch222.big, meant to fix fontsubstitution/video.ini/lotr.str without touching _patch222.big/ini.big directly) was tried and ABANDONED this session. Two real problems found with it, in addition to it just being more moving parts than needed:
1. If an old copy fails to delete (Windows 'device or resource busy' because the game still holds the file open) it keeps loading with its STALE content and silently overrides whatever direct fixes you make afterward to _patch222.big -- this caused a full regression to English text that looked like the direct-edit method 'stopped working' when actually the stale _patch223.big was still winning. ALWAYS verify deletion succeeded (re-list the directory) before trusting a direct edit to take effect.
2. It doesn't save any real complexity over the direct-edit method below, and adds a whole extra failure mode. CURRENT METHOD (confirmed working by the user, screenshot-verified Ukrainian main menu): edit _patch222.big and ini.big DIRECTLY in place -- remove data\lotr.str entirely from _patch222.big, and patch data\ini\fontsubstitution.ini (SachaWynterTight -> "Albertus MT") in BOTH _patch222.big AND ini.big (see font_duplicate_fontsubstitution_WARNING below for why both). Do NOT reintroduce the _patch223.big overlay approach unless a future problem specifically requires not touching _patch222.big/ini.big (e.g. an auto-updater that re-verifies/restores them) -- and if you do, make sure deletion of any earlier overlay attempt is CONFIRMED before moving on.
meta.sachawyntertight_pua_decoration_WARNING: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-31 -- the PUA-icon premise below was checked directly and is WRONG. Dumped every glyph name in sachwt__.ttf via fontTools: it is a completely ordinary Western/Central European character set (accented Latin, punctuation, a handful of math symbols) plus exactly two Private-Use-Area entries at 0xF001/0xF002 -- rendered them with PIL and they are the "fi"/"fl" typographic ligatures in the font's own gothic style, NOT decorative icons. Nothing is lost by redirecting FontSubstitution "SachaWynter" straight to "Albertus MT" (confirmed: this is exactly what the official Chinese and Thai localizations do). The garbled-rune artifacts this note originally blamed on lost icon glyphs were, like everywhere else in this project, just missing-Cyrillic-glyph fallback rendering. Kept for the historical reasoning trail -- ORIGINAL note follows below, its central claim is not reliable. || ORIGINAL: RESOLVED 2026-08-31. Root cause of a WIDESPREAD, recurring 'garbled rune-like gibberish' artifact seen all over the game (main menu button sub-captions, credits scroll, tutorial screen decorative divider, world map roster tooltip -- anywhere at all, not one specific screen) that had been repeatedly misdiagnosed as the already-solved mojibake/MISSING-label bugs. Actual cause: the stock font sachwt__.ttf (family name literally 'SachaWynterTight', TrueType/glyf, 242 glyphs) carries DECORATIVE/ICON glyphs in the Unicode Private Use Area (0xF000-0xF002 confirmed, likely more) used by the game's UI chrome -- NOT real text, no CSF label maps to them. The earlier fix (data\ini\fontsubstitution.ini redirecting FontSubstitution "SachaWynter" -> "Albertus MT", done to get Cyrillic into SachaWynter-styled UI text like mission captions/subtitles/countdown timers) ALSO redirects every consumer of that font family, including this decorative/icon usage -- Albertus MT has no glyphs at those PUA codepoints, so the engine draws garbage there instead of the intended icon. Confirmed by inspecting sachwt__.ttf directly (fontTools cmap dump) and reasoning through the mechanism, not by guessing. PROPER FIX (do this whenever a Cyrillic-glyph font swap touches a font family used for non-letter decoration too): do NOT redirect the family via fontsubstitution.ini at all -- instead extend the ORIGINAL font file itself with the missing Cyrillic glyphs, keeping literally everything else (all 242 original glyphs incl. the PUA icons) byte-for-byte untouched, and register the extended file via LocalFontFile under the font's OWN existing name (no substitution/spoofing needed). Built as bfme1/fonts/sachawyntertight_ua.ttf (74 Cyrillic glyphs added, glyph outlines converted CFF-cubic -> TrueType-quadratic from albertusmt_ua.otf via the `cu2qu` package since sachwt__.ttf is glyf-based and albertusmt_ua.otf is CFF-based -- these are different outline formats, you cannot just copy glyph data across, cu2qu handles the curve conversion). fontsubstitution.ini reverted back to stock (SachaWynter -> SachaWynterTight, both _patch222.big and ini.big -- see font_duplicate_fontsubstitution_WARNING for why both copies) since sachawyntertight_ua.ttf is now Cyrillic-capable on its own. LESSON for the NEXT font that needs Cyrillic (Hungarian/Arabic/anything): before redirecting ANY font family via fontsubstitution.ini, first check whether that family is used for non-letter/decorative purposes anywhere (dump its cmap and look for Private Use Area codepoints 0xE000-0xF8FF, or just check every 'Font =' role in language.ini that names it) -- if so, extend the original font in place instead of substituting, exactly like this fix and like the original albertusmt_ua.otf approach (which already followed this rule correctly for Albertus MT, and was never the buggy one).
meta.font_duplicate_fontsubstitution_WARNING: data\ini\fontsubstitution.ini exists as a SEPARATE copy in BOTH _patch222.big AND ini.big. Whichever archive wins at that path for a given install determines whether SachaWynter is redirected to "Albertus MT" or not -- and we do NOT have a proven, authoritative rule for which of the two wins (patches are assumed to have priority over base archives since that's their whole purpose, but this was NEVER empirically confirmed here; a real bug was once caused by fixing only one of the two and having the OTHER, unpatched copy win instead -- possibly because archive load order is filename-based, e.g. alphabetical, where '_patch222.big' (starts with '_', byte value below any letter) could sort/load BEFORE 'ini.big', letting ini.big win despite being the 'base' archive). RULE: always patch fontsubstitution.ini in BOTH archives, every time, regardless of which one you think should logically win. Same caution applies to any other file that exists as a duplicate across multiple loaded archives (language.ini, video.ini) -- check with a quick pyBIG listing before assuming only one copy needs fixing.
meta.apt_namespace_no_csf_fallback_WARNING: RESOLVED (previously logged as an OPEN PROBLEM -- that status was wrong/incomplete, corrected below). Patch 2.22's redesigned in-game Options screen uses a DIFFERENT label namespace ('APT:Options', 'APT:DisplayOptions', 'APT:AudioControls', etc, ~450 labels, all in this JSON's 'strings' with en/ua text) than the classic menu system ('GUI:Options', 'GUI:Skirmish', etc). The ORIGINAL finding still holds: if data\lotr.str EXISTS as a file (anywhere in the loaded archive stack) but a given APT: label isn't found inside it, the engine shows literally 'MISSING: <label>' instead of checking the CSF -- confirmed by shipping a data\lotr.str containing ZERO labels (present-but-empty) and watching the whole Options screen go MISSING even though the CSF had correct text. What was actually WRONG in that old note: the fix is NOT 'keep a small data\lotr.str with just the APT: labels'. Tried exactly that this session (a non-destructive drop-in _patch222ua.big shipping data\lotr.str with ONLY the ~450 APT: labels) and it broke a DIFFERENT screen -- the world map showed 'MISSING: LWA:ElvesArmy' and 'MISSING: BANNERUI:SummaryUnitQuantity'. So APT: is not special/alone -- LWA: and BANNERUI: (and likely other namespaces, not exhaustively catalogued) have the exact same 'no CSF fallback while data\lotr.str exists' behavior. A partial/curated .str will always miss some namespace you didn't think to include. CONFIRMED WORKING FIX: delete data\lotr.str ENTIRELY (the file must not exist at all in any loaded archive, not just be empty or partial) and make sure literally every label that used to live only in that .str -- APT:, LWA:, BANNERUI:, CONTROLBAR:, GUI:, everything -- is present in the CSF instead (this JSON's full 'strings' merge already covers this: 8582 labels including all patch-2.22-added content). With data\lotr.str fully absent, ALL namespaces including APT:/LWA:/BANNERUI: fall back to the CSF correctly -- re-tested end to end on a fresh clean 2.22 English install 2026-08-30 (options screen, world map, main menu all correct, no MISSING anywhere). So the real rule is: 'no CSF fallback' only manifests when data\lotr.str is PRESENT and incomplete for that label; total absence of the file is safe for every namespace tested so far. Never ship a curated/partial data\lotr.str again -- it's strictly worse than deleting it, since you can't know in advance which namespaces need it.
meta.str_cp1251_mojibake_font_hijack_FIX: While briefly using a partial data\lotr.str (see apt_namespace_no_csf_fallback_WARNING -- since abandoned), Cyrillic text written into it as cp1251 bytes rendered as mojibake (readable Latin-looking glyphs like 'ÑÀÎÎÑÒ²ÉÀ') because .str is read through the machine's ANSI codepage (cp1252 on this PC), not cp1251 -- see text_source_priority_WARNING. Fixed permanently at the FONT level rather than relying on any Windows locale setting: fonts\albertusmt_ua.otf now has extra cmap entries at U+0080-U+00FF (Latin-1 Supplement/C1) that point to the SAME glyphs as their cp1251-equivalent Cyrillic characters (e.g. U+00D1 'Ñ' now draws Cyrillic 'С', U+00B2 '²' now draws Ukrainian 'І') -- computed programmatically for the whole 0x80-0xFF range via bytes([b]).decode('cp1252') vs .decode('cp1251') and copying glyph IDs across in fontTools. This makes any FUTURE single-byte cp1251 text forced through .str render correctly regardless of the host machine's system locale, with zero dependency on Windows regional settings. Not currently load-bearing (the confirmed fix above avoids .str entirely), but keep this hijack in the font permanently as a safety net -- it's additive-only and doesn't affect the font's real Unicode Cyrillic block (U+0400+) used by the normal CSF path.
meta.drop_in_patch_overlay_technique_DISCOVER: Discovered/confirmed 2026-08-30, corrects an overly narrow earlier claim in ea_official_vs_community_patch_methodology_WARNING ('root-level _patchNNN.big archives cannot touch lang\\<language>\\lotr.csf at all'). That was true only because 2.22's OWN patch chose not to ship a CSF -- NOT an engine limitation. Proof: F:\BFME1's own _frenchpatch106.big, _patch106russian.big and _russianpatch106.big all ship real lang\\<language>\\lotr.csf (plus embedded fonts, per-language fontsubstitution.ini) inside plain BIGF-header patch archives, successfully overriding the base lang\\<language>.big's CSF at the exact same path. A root-level _patchNNN.big CAN carry a full CSF+font -- it's just that most patches don't bother. Confirmed empirically by building our own drop-in overlays (_patch106ua.big for a French 1.06 install, _patch222ua.big for 2.22 English) that ship lang\\<language>\\lotr.csf + language.ini + fontsubstitution.ini + the font file, named to sort alphabetically AFTER the archive they need to beat (e.g. '_patch222ua.big' > '_patch222.big' because 'u' > '.') -- these load automatically with NO '-mod' flag needed, and the game picks them up over the stock archives. Also confirmed the '-mod' command-line flag itself is repeatable (lotrbfme.exe -mod \"a.big\" -mod \"b.big\" loads both, later one taking priority for overlapping paths) as a SEPARATE mechanism from the auto-discovered root-level _patchNNN.big convention. CAVEAT discovered on 1.06/French specifically: the exact archive-loading PATH CASING matters for priority matching (official patches use lowercase 'lang\\french\\lotr.csf', not the base archive's own 'Lang\\French\\lotr.csf' mixed-case convention) -- match whatever casing the archive you're trying to beat actually uses, don't assume the base game's own casing. NOT used for the final working 2.22 fix in this session (that went back to the direct-edit method per patch223_overlay_ABANDONED_WARNING, specifically because a drop-in .str for 2.22 can't safely be scoped to 'just the namespaces that need it' -- see apt_namespace_no_csf_fallback_WARNING) -- but this technique is a real, confirmed-working option for any FUTURE case where not touching the original archives at all is a hard requirement (e.g. a distributable non-destructive package), as long as it ships a COMPLETE CSF (not a partial .str).
meta.registry_language_selector_WARNING:
Confirmed which registry value actually picks the active lang\<X>.big / lang\<X>audio.big pair -- HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Electronic Arts\EA Games\The Battle for Middle-earth, value 'Language' (REG_SZ, e.g. 'English'). Confirmed via direct binary string search in lotrbfme.exe: it contains literal format-string templates 'Lang\%s\Lotr.csf', 'Lang\%s\Language.ini', 'Lang\%s\Language9x.ini', 'Lang\%s\HeaderTemplate.ini', 'Lang\%s\HeaderTemplate9x.ini', 'Lang\%s\CommandMap.ini', 'Lang\%s\TOS.txt' -- the '%s' is filled in from this registry value at startup. This means: (1) multiple lang\*.big files (e.g. english.big AND french.big) can coexist harmlessly in the same folder with zero conflict/priority between them -- only the ONE matching the registry 'Language' value is ever opened; (2) you can switch the active language WITHOUT reinstalling by just editing this one registry string and having the matching lang\<value>.big present. This is the real, official EA mechanism (not an ALI213-crack-specific trick as first guessed -- that guess was wrong, corrected same session).
UNRESOLVED SUB-QUESTION: the exe also contains a SEPARATE string 'AudioLanguage' (distinct from 'Language'), suggesting speech/audio language might be independently selectable from text language. However: no 'AudioLanguage' value actually exists anywhere in this system's registry (checked HKLM and HKCU trees exhaustively), it is undocumented in every modding community source checked (Revora, HeavenGames, OpenSAGE), and the exact code path that reads/sets it was NOT traced (would require real disassembly, not just a strings scan). Do NOT assume AudioLanguage behaves like Language until this is empirically tested -- e.g. by placing a mislabeled audio archive (French speech data saved under the filename lang\englishaudio.big while Language=English) and confirming in-game which speech actually plays. Also note: the separate string 'LanguageFilter' / 'Options::FilterLanguage' found nearby is UNRELATED to spoken language -- it's the game's profanity/content filter, don't confuse the two when grepping exe strings.
meta.distributable_installer_toolkit_PLANNED:
PLANNED, NOT YET BUILT as of this note -- design agreed with the user for a 'v0.1' installer package a non-technical friend can run in seconds against their own copy of the game:
- Version detection: filename-pattern based (scan for _patch222*.big -- if present, apply the current 2.22-specific patch logic; if the pattern doesn't match a known supported version, DO NOT auto-patch, print a warning instead -- explicitly rejected a SHA256-hash-based version table as too fragile/high-maintenance, since every new official patch build would produce a brand-new hash requiring a manual update just to recognize it as 'the same 2.22 family'). This mirrors the archive-header lesson: never guess blindly, but keep the check cheap.
- Packaging: a Python Embeddable Package (python.org, ~15MB, no install needed) + a vendored copy of pyBIG's pure-Python source (no C extensions, so no pip/compile step needed) + install_ua.py (merges rebuild_lang_english.py + the direct _patch222.big/ini.big fontsubstitution/lotr.str fix into one script) + data/bfme1_localization.json + data/albertusmt_ua.otf + install.bat (thin wrapper: python\python.exe install_ua.py, then pause so the console doesn't vanish before the friend can read the report). Rationale for embeddable-Python over a PyInstaller onefile .exe: translation/data updates only need replacing the .json, no rebuild step, easier to iterate publicly.
- Auto-reapply-on-update idea: since a game update / verify-integrity can silently reset lang\english.big, _patch222.big AND ini.big back to stock (confirmed happens from an accidental Steam-style patch redownload this session), the plan is a launcher-wrapper -- rename the real lotrbfme.exe to lotrbfme_orig.exe and drop a thin checker in its place named lotrbfme.exe, which does the cheap _patch222*.big-presence + already-patched check on every launch and silently re-patches before handing off to lotrbfme_orig.exe. Rejected alternatives: a background watcher/Scheduled Task (heavier, looks suspicious to antivirus for 'watching game files'), and Steam launch-options wrapping (only works for Steam copies, requires the friend to configure it manually).
NEXT STEPS when actually building this: write install_ua.py combining the logic already proven working in rebuild_lang_english_v2.py + direct_patch_222_and_ini.py (both in this session's scratchpad, not yet copied into the toolkit repo permanently -- do that first), add the backup-before-first-run + idempotency check, then package per the above.

strings.en: This computer has the Windows XP SP2 firewall enabled. An entry must be added to the firewall exemption list to play The Battle for Middle-earth. Do you want the game to automatically add this entry?
strings.ua: На цьому комп'ютері включена Windows XP SP2 Firewall. Вхід слід додавати до списку звільнення від firewall для гри в Битву за Середзем'я. Ви хочете, щоб гра автоматично додала цей вхід?
strings.ru: В вашей системе обнаружен брандмауэр Windows XP SP2. Для корректного функционирования игры необходимо добавить строку в список исключений этого брандмауэра. Вы хотите, чтобы это было сделано автоматически?
strings.fr: Le pare-feu de Windows XP SP2 est activé sur votre ordinateur. Pour jouer, vous devez ajouter La Bataille pour la Terre du Milieu™ à la liste d'exceptions du pare-feu. Etes-vous d'accord pour que le jeu ajoute cette autorisation automatiquement ?
strings.es: Tu ordenador tiene activado el firewall de XP SP2. Para jugar a La Batalla por la Tierrra Media tendrás que añadir esta aplicación a la lista de excepciones del firewall. ¿Quieres que el juego se añada automáticamente a la lista?
strings.de: Auf deinem Computer ist die Firewall von Windows XP (SP2) aktiviert. Um Die Schlacht um Mittelerde zu spielen, muss diese Anwendung zur Liste der Firewall-Ausnahmen hinzufügt werden. Soll das Spiel diesen Eintrag automatisch hinzufügen?
strings.it: Questo computer ha attivato il firewall di Windows XP SP2. Per poter giocare a La Battaglia per la Terra di Mezzo, devi aggiungere l'applicazione all'elenco delle eccezioni del firewall. Vuoi che il gioco aggiunga automaticamente questa voce?

strings.en: The game could not add itself to the Windows XP SP2 firewall application exemption list because you do not have administrator privileges. Please run the game once from an Administrator account (see the README file for more details).
strings.ua: Гра не може додатися сама до звільнення від додатка Windows XP SP2 Firewall, так як у вас немає привілеїв адміністратора. Запустіть цю гру ще раз під акаунтом Адміністратора (дивіться файл README для перегляду деталей).
strings.ru: Не удалось добавить строку в список исключений брандмауэры Windows XP SP2: у вас нет прав администратора системы. Войдите в систему с использованием учетной записи администратора и запустите игру (подробнее см. файл README).
strings.fr: Le jeu n'a pas pu être ajouté à la liste d'exceptions du pare-feu car vous n'avez pas les droits administrateur sur ce PC. Veuillez de nouveau exécuter le jeu à partir d'un compte d'Administrateur (voir le fichier LisezMoi pour plus de détails).
strings.es: El juego no se puede añadir a la lista de excepciones del firewall de Windows XP SP2, porque no tienes privilegios de administrador. Por favor, ejecuta el juego desde una cuenta de administrador (ver archivo léeme para más detalles).
strings.de: Das Spiel konnte sich nicht in die Anwendungen-Liste deiner Firewall eintragen, da du keine Administratorrechte hast. Bitte starte das Spiel von einem Konto mit Administratorrechten. Weitere Informationen dazu findest du in der Readme-Datei.
strings.it: Il gioco non ha potuto aggiungersi all'elenco delle eccezioni del firewall di Windows XP SP2 perché on disponi dei privilegi di amministrazione su questo sistema. Avvia il gioco con un account da amministratore (per ulteriori dettagli consulta il file Leggimi).

strings.en:
Battle for Middle-earth is unable to connect to other player(s). If the problem persists, and you have a NAT or Firewall device or software: 
 Click on the Refresh NAT button in the options menu. If you have a DLink device, click the Send Delay button in the options menu. If you are still unable to connect, consider opening a port in your firewall. Consult the manual and readme for details.
strings.ua:
Битві за Середзем'я не вдалося підключитися до іншого гравця(ів). Якщо проблема залишається і у вас включені NAT або Firewall пристрою або програми:
 Клікніть кнопку Оновити NAT в меню опцій. Якщо у вас пристрій DLink, клікніть кнопку Послати Затримку в меню опцій. Якщо ви все ще не можете підключитися, знадобиться відкрити порт у вашій Firewall. Проконсультуйтеся з керівництвом і файлом readme.
strings.ru:
Не удалось установить связь с другими участниками игры. 
 Если эта проблема повторяется, а в вашей системе используется NAT или брандмауэр: щелкните на кнопке "Обновление NAT" в меню настройки. 
 При использовании устройства DLink щелкните на кнопке "Задержка отправки" в меню настройки. Если это не поможет, откройте требуемый порт. 
 За подробностями обратитесь к Руководству пользователя игры и файлу README.
strings.fr:
Bataille pour la Terre du Milieu ne peut pas se connecter à d'autres joueurs. Si le problème persiste et que vous possédez un NAT ou un pare-feu : 
 Cliquez sur le bouton Actualiser NAT du menu Options. Si vous avez un dispositif Dlink, cliquez sur le bouton Délai envoi du menu Options. Si la connexion est toujours impossible, ouvrez un port dans votre pare-feu. Pour plus de détails, consultez le manuel et le fichier LisezMoi.
strings.es:
La Batalla por la Tierra Media no puede conectarse con otro(s) jugador(es). Si el problema continúa y tienes NAT o un Firewall: 
 Haz clic sobre el botón Actualizar NAT del menú de opciones. Si tienes un dispositivo DLink, haz clic sobre el botón Enviar retardo del menú de opciones. Si sigues sin ser capaz de conectarte, piensa en abrir un puerto de tu firewall. Si quieres más detalles, consulta el manual y el archivo léeme.
strings.de:
Die Schlacht von Mittelerde konnte keine Verbindung zu anderen Spielern herstellen. Wenn das Problem weiterhin auftritt und du eine NAT oder eine Firewall hast, 
 klicke im Optionen-Menü auf "NAT aktualisieren". Hast du ein DLink-Gerät, klicke im Optionen-Menü auf "Delay senden". Kannst du immer noch keine Verbindung herstellen, solltest du in deiner Firewall einen zusätzlichen Port freigeben. Weitere Informationen dazu findest du im Handbuch und in der Readme-Datei.
strings.it:
La Battaglia per la Terra di Mezzo non è in grado di connettersi con gli altri giocatori. Se il problema persiste e il tuo PC è sotto NAT o dietro un firewall: 
 Clicca sul pulsante Aggiorna NAT nel menu delle opzioni. Se hai un router D-Link, clicca sul pulsante Invia ritardo nel menu delle opzioni. Se ancora non riesci a connetterti, prova ad aprire una porta nel tuo firewall. Per ulteriori dettagli, consulta il manuale e il file Leggimi.

strings.en:
Skirmish progress for this player. 
 1 point for defeating an Easy enemy, 
 2 points for a Medium enemy, 
 3 points for a Hard enemy 
 and 4 points for a map with a maximum number of Hard enemies
strings.ua:
Досягнення в Сутичках для цього гравця.
 1 очко за перемогу над Легким супротивником,
 2 очки за Помірного супротивника,
 3 очки за Складного супротивника
 і 4 очки за карту з максимальною кількістю Складних супротивників
strings.ru:
Ваши успехи в режиме сражения. 
 Победа над новичком - 1 очко. 
 Победа над воителем - 2 очка. 
 Победа над ветераном - 3 очка. 
 Победа над максимальным числом противников-ветеранов - 4 очка.
strings.fr:
Progression Escarmouche pour ce joueur. 
 1 point en battant un ennemi Facile, 
 2 points pour un ennemi Normal, 
 3 points pour un ennemi Difficile 
 et 4 points en battant le maximum d'ennemis Difficiles sur une carte.
strings.es:
Subir de nivel en batalla rápida. Se gana 1 punto por derrotar a un enemigo Fácil, 
 2 puntos por uno Normal, 
 3 puntos por una Difícil y 4 puntos por ganar en mapas con el número máximo de enemigos difíciles
strings.de:
Punktesystem: Für einen Sieg über einen leichten Gegner bekommst du 1 Punkt. 
 Siege über mittlere Gegner werden mit 2, 
 Siege über schwere Gegner mit 3 Punkten belohnt. 
 Meisterst du eine Karte mit der maximalen Zahl schwerer Gegner, bekommst du 4 Punkte.
strings.it:
Progresso della schermaglia del giocatore. 
 1 punto per la sconfitta di un nemico Facile, 
 2 punti per un nemico Medio, 
 3 punti per un nemico Difficile e 
 4 punti per una mappa con il numero massimo di avversari di livello Difficile.

strings.en:
Choose the acceptable tolerance for opponent's connection speed. 
 The lower the number the faster the connection
strings.ua:
Виберіть допустиму швидкість з'єднання опонента.
 Чим нижче число тим швидше з'єднання
strings.ru:
Указание допустимого качества связи соперников. 
 Чем меньше число, тем выше качество связи.
strings.fr:
Choisissez une vitesse de connexion acceptable pour votre adversaire 
 Plus le chiffre est bas, plus la connexion sera rapide
strings.es:
Elige la tolerancia aceptable para la velocidad de conexión de los oponentes. 
 Cuanto menor sea el número, más rápida será la conexión
strings.de:
Bestimme die gewünschte Verbindungsgeschwindigkeit des Gegners. 
 Je niedriger dieser Wert ist, desto schneller ist die Verbindung.
strings.it:
Scegli la tolleranza accettabile per la velocità di connessione dell'avversario. 
 Più il valore è basso, più la connessione è rapida.

strings.en:
Choose the acceptable tolerance for opponent's disconnection total. 
 Higher disconnect totals indicates slower connection to opponents
strings.ua:
Оберіть припустимий допуск для суми роз'єднання опонента.
 Більша сума роз'єднання означає більш повільне з'єднання для опонента
strings.ru:
Указание допустимого количества разрывов связи для соперников. 
 Чем больше разрывов, тем ниже качество связи.
strings.fr:
Choisissez le total de déconnexions acceptables pour votre adversaire 
 Un nombre élevé indique une connexion plus lente aux adversaires
strings.es:
Elige la tolerancia aceptable para el total de desconexiones de los oponentes. 
 Un total de desconexiones más alto supone una conexión más lenta de los oponentes
strings.de:
Bestimme die maximale Zahl der Verbindungsabbrüche deiner Gegner. 
 Je höher dieser Wert ist, desto langsamer ist die Verbindung.
strings.it:
Scegli la tolleranza accettabile per il totale di disconnessioni dell'avversario. 
 I valori elevati indicano una connessione lenta agli avversari.

strings.en:
To ignore a Player, Left click on a name 
 and Left click on the Ignore Player box. 
 Ignored players or their messages will not be visible
strings.ua:
Для того, щоб ігнорувати гравця, натисніть лівою кнопкою миші на імені
 і клікніть на вікні Ігнорувати Гравця.
 Ігноровані гравці і їхні повідомлення не будуть відображатися
strings.ru:
Чтобы игнорировать все сообщения, 
 поступающие от игрока, 
 щелкните на его имени, 
 а затем в поле "Игнорировать".
strings.fr:
Pour ignorer un Joueur, clic gauche sur 
 un nom puis sur Ignorer joueur. 
 Les joueurs ignorés et leurs messages seront invisibles.
strings.es:
Para ignorar a un jugador, haz clic con el botón izquierdo sobre un nombre 
 y, a continuación, hazlo sobre la casilla Ignorar Jugador. 
 Los jugadores ignorados o 
 sus mensajes no serán visibles
strings.de:
Um einen Spieler zu ignorieren, klicke auf 
 einen Namen und dann auf das Kästchen 
 Spieler ignorieren. Ignorierte Spieler oder ihre 
 Nachrichten sind nicht sichtbar.
strings.it:
Per ignorare un giocatore, clicca con il pulsante 
 sinistro su un nome, quindi seleziona il riquadro 
 Ignora giocatore. I giocatori ignorati 
 e i loro messaggi non sono visibili.

strings.en:
To remove a Player from the Ignore list, 
 Left click on a name and Left click on the Remove Ignore button
strings.ua:
Для того, щоб прибрати гравця зі списку ігнорованих,
 натисніть на ім'я, а потім на кнопку Прибрати Ігнорування
strings.ru:
Чтобы исключить игрока из списка игнорируемых, щелкните 
 на его имени, а затем в поле "Удалить".
strings.fr:
Pour enlever un Joueur de la liste Ignorer, 
 clic gauche sur un nom puis sur le bouton Supprimer à Ignorer.
strings.es:
Para eliminar a un jugador de la lista de ignorados, 
 haz clic con el botón izquierdo sobre un nombre y clic con el botón izquierdo sobre el botón Eliminar Ignorar
strings.de:
Um einen Spieler von der Ignorieren-Liste zu löschen, 
 klicke auf einen Namen und dann auf den Button Nicht ignorieren.
strings.it:
Per rimuovere un giocatore dall'elenco degli ignorati, 
 clicca con il pulsante sinistro sul suo nome e seleziona 
 l'opzione Rimuovi ignorato.

strings.en:
To remove a Friend, Left click on a name 
 and Left click on the Remove Friend button
strings.ua:
Для того, щоб прибрати Друга, натисніть лівою кнопкою миші на ім'я
, а потім на кнопку Прибрати Друга
strings.ru:
Чтобы удалить игрока, щелкните левой кнопкой мыши на его имени, 
 а затем на кнопке "Удалить игрока"
strings.fr:
Pour enlever un Ami, clic gauche sur son nom 
 puis sur le bouton Supprimer Ami.
strings.es:
Para eliminar a un amigo, haz clic con el botón izquierdo sobre un 
 nombre y clic con el botón izquierdo sobre el botón Eliminar Amigo
strings.de:
Um einen Freund zu löschen, klicke auf einen Namen 
 und dann auf den Button Freund entfernen.
strings.it:
Per rimuovere un giocatore dall'elenco degli amici, 
 clicca con il pulsante sinistro sul suo nome e seleziona 
 l'opzione Rimuovi amico.

strings.en:
To create a Friend, Left click on 
 a name in the Player list, 
 then Left click the Add Friend box
strings.ua:
Щоб створити Друга, натисніть лівою кнопкою на
 ім'я в списку Гравців,
 а потім, на вікно Додати Друга
strings.ru:
Чтобы добавить игрока в список друзей, 
 щелкните сначала на его имени, 
 а затем на кнопке "В список друзей".
strings.fr:
Pour créer un Ami, clic gauche sur 
 un nom dans la liste des Joueurs 
 puis clic gauche sur Ajouter Ami.
strings.es:
Para crear un amigo, haz clic con el botón izquierdo sobre 
 un nombre de la lista de jugadores, 
 a continuación, haz clic con el botón izquierdo sobre la casilla Añadir Amigo
strings.de:
Um einen Freund zu erstellen, klicke auf 
 einen Namen in der Spielerliste und 
 klicke dann auf das Kästchen Freund hinzufügen.
strings.it:
Per creare un amico, clicca con il pulsante sinistro 
 su un nome nell'elenco dei giocatori, 
 quindi seleziona il riquadro Aggiungi amico.

Налаштуйте роздільну здатність екрану.

Выбор разрешения экрана.

 если меню настройки вызвано из главного меню.
strings.fr:
Réglez la résolution graphique du jeu.

 qu'à l'aide des Options du Menu principal

Ajusta la resolución gráfica del juego. n Esta opción solo se puede cambiar desde 
 Opciones en el Menú Principal
strings.it:
Regola la risoluzione video. 
 Questa impostazione può essere modificata solo 
 tramite la voce Opzioni del menu principale.

Adjusting details too high may slow 
 the gameplay for lower end PCs. 
 This setting can only be changed 
 from the Options in the Main Menu

Встановлення дуже високого рівня деталізації може сповільнити
 геймплей на слабких ПК.

 із Опцій у Головному Меню

 если меню настройки вызвано из главного меню.
strings.fr:
Un niveau de détail trop élevé peut ralentir 
 le jeu sur les PC anciens. 
 Ce réglage ne peut être modifié 
 qu'à l'aide des Options du Menu principal
strings.es:
Subir el nivel de detalle demasiado 
 puede ralentizar el juego en un PC poco potente. 
 Esta opción solo se puede cambiar n desde el Opciones en el Menú Principal
strings.de:
Bestimme den Detailgrad der Einheiten, Strukturen und Spezialeffekte. 
 Ist der Detailgrad zu hoch, läuft das Spiel auf leistungsschwächeren PCs möglicherweise langsamer.
strings.it:
Un livello di dettaglio troppo elevato può rallentare 
 il gioco sui PC meno potenti. 
 Questa impostazione può essere modificata solo 
 tramite la voce Opzioni del menu principale.

strings.en: Toggle on to prevent Asian character messages in chat and in game

Повышение четкости текстур.

strings.en: You cannot build there because it is too close to a source of supplies.
strings.ua: Ви не можете тут будувати, занадто близько до джерела ресурсів.
strings.ru: Строительство невозможно - источник ресурсов находится слишком близко.
strings.fr: Vous êtes trop près d'une zone de ressources pour pouvoir construire.
strings.es: No puedes construir aquí porque está demasiado cerca de una fuente de recursos.
strings.de: In unmittelbarer Nähe zu einer Rohstoffquelle kannst du nichts bauen!
strings.it: Non puoi costruire qui perché sei troppo vicino a una fonte di risorse.

strings.ua: Одиниця не може потрапити на будмайданчик.
strings.es: La unidad no puede llegar al lugar de construcción.
strings.de: Der Weg zur Baustelle ist versperrt.
strings.it: L'unità non riesce a raggiungere il cantiere.

strings.en: You must explore there before building.
strings.ua: Ви повинні дослідити там перед будівництвом.
strings.fr: Explorez cette zone avant de construire.
strings.es: Antes de edificar, tienes que explorar.
strings.de: Du musst das Gelände erforschen, bevor du etwas bauen kannst.
strings.it: Devi esplorare la zona, prima di costruire.

strings.en: Unable to set rally point, object(s) are in the way of the destination.
strings.ua: Неможливо встановити точку збору, об'єкт(и) на шляху до місця призначення.
strings.ru: Препятствие на пути следования - установить точку сбора невозможно
strings.fr: Impossible d'établir point de ralliement, il y a un/des obstacle(s).
strings.es: Imposible fijar punto de concentración, el(los) objeto(s) van de camino.
strings.de: Sammelpunkt kann nicht bestimmt werden, da Objekte den Weg zum Ziel versperren.
strings.it: Impossibile impostare il punto di raccolta. Ci sono ostacoli che bloccano il percorso.
Impossibile impostare il punto di raccolta.

strings.en: Rally point set for all buildings.
strings.ua: Точка збору встановлена для всіх будівель.
strings.fr: Point de ralliement défini pour tous les bâtiments.
strings.es: Punto de concentración para todos los edificios.
strings.it: Punto di raccolta impostato per tutti gli edifici.

strings.en: Commands your forces to exult over your great deeds.
strings.ua: Командує вашими військами для тріумфування над вашими великими діяннями.
strings.ru: Получив эту команду, солдаты громко поприветствуют своего командира.
strings.fr: Ordonne à vos unités de se réjouir de vos exploits.
strings.es: Comanda tus tropas para disfrutar de tus hazañas.
strings.de: Befehle deinen Truppen, deine Heldentaten zu feiern.
strings.it: Ordina alle tue forze di esultare quando compi grandi imprese.

strings.ru: Размещение выбранного объекта на указанной позиции.

strings.en: Set the selected object(s) into 'guard area' mode.
strings.ua: Встановіть обраний об'єкт(и) в режим "охорони території".
strings.ru: Получив эту команду, выбранные боевые единицы станут охранять территорию.
strings.fr: Le/les objet(s) sélectionné(s) passe(nt) en mode Protéger.
strings.es: Poner al objeto(s) seleccionado(s) en modo "Proteger zona"

strings.it: Imposta gli oggetti selezionati nella modalità Sorveglianza.

strings.en: Create a formation of the selected units and they will retain it as they move.

strings.de: Befehle den gewählten Truppen, in Formation vorzurücken.
strings.it: Crea una formazione che le unità selezionate manterranno anche durante gli spostamenti.

strings.en: Toggle follow state of selected object(s).

strings.fr: Active le suivi du/des objet(s) sélectionné(s).

strings.it: Alterna la modalità di inseguimento degli oggetti selezionati.

strings.en: Toggles the in game control bar on/off.

strings.ua: Перемикач Режим Буквенного Вікна в увімк/вимк.
